decisions.statement: Every path a change names is asked for the warrants that path has.
A path clears its warrant by answering rather than by going unasked.
A reading answers for a warrant by object id alone rather than by when the object was read.
A body only part of which reached the agent answers no warrant.
A body read in part is owed as read in part rather than as changed.
What a refusal says of one reading owed is composed elsewhere.
A warrant carries the page it ran over as well as the page it owes.
The page a warrant ran over is attached here rather than by each warrant.
The readings owed are held to the ceiling one answer carries.
The list is held to that ceiling here rather than by the list's reader.
A call charged to no agent is refused whole and said to be impossible rather than merely wrong.
Nothing here writes the repository.
Nothing here commits.
A taboo term's page a refusal hands back is recorded as read here.
Warranting is asked and warranting answers.
A warrant is the reading a change owes rather than the reading changing a warranted file would owe.
A read is handed each named path followed by the paths warrants running on read name for the path.
Within the paths a read is handed a path sits once in the place that path first sat.
Warrants that cannot be worked out hand back the paths handed in.
The page a seat owes from sits at its id.
An agent owes the readings its own page names rather than the page itself.
The page a subagent owes from sits at the seat's name and the id the subagent runs under.
A subagent owes the readings its own page names rather than the readings its seat's page names.
An agent that sits at no page owes nothing of a page.
A warrant owed of a taboo term is said before every warrant that is not.
A page a refusal hands back clears the warrant owed of that page.
A refusal says the call was refused rather than leaving the exit code to say it.
Warrants owed of no taboo term keep the order the warrants were worked out in.
A change's readings and the writing seat's readings are ordered as one answer rather than two lists.
Nothing is changed that its writer has not read.

definition: the readings a change owes, and which of them the record does not answer for
